title: Amazon EventBridge to AWS Lambda
description: Create an EventBridge rule that invokes a Lambda function

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This template deploys a Lambda function that is triggered by an EventBridge rule. In this example, the rule filters for specific attributes in the event before invoking the function.
The Events section of the AWS::Serverless::Function type also sets up the required permissions for EventBridge to invoke this specific function.

bullets.text: Reducing custom code by using advanced rules in Amazon EventBridge
Use Amazon EventBridge to Build Decoupled, Event-Driven Architectures

testing.headline: Testing
text: Use the AWS CLI to send a test event to EventBridge and observe the event delivered to the Lambda function:
1. Send an event to EventBridge: aws events put-events --entries file://event.json.
2. Retrieve the logs from the Lambda function: sam logs -n ENTER_YOUR_CONSUMER_FUNCTION_NAME.

cleanup.headline: Cleanup
text: 2. Confirm the stack has been deleted: aws cloudformation list-stacks --query "StackSummaries[?contains(StackName,'STACK_NAME')].StackStatus"
